# Scope and deliver a professional services engagement

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When the company sells a defined consulting, implementation or other services project. An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is UK public-sector practice; adapted operational coordination. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

## Outcomes

- An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Translate the requested outcome into deliverables

agent-runnable


Record the customer problem, deliverables, exclusions, dependencies and acceptance evidence. Identify who supplies access and decisions, and label estimates separately from commitments.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve scope capacity and contractual risk

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The delivery and commercial owners review staffing, milestones, payment terms, intellectual property and liability with relevant advisers. Resolve obligations the team cannot fulfill before proposing the engagement.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Execute the approved engagement agreement

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized signatories approve and sign the reviewed statement of work and agreement. Retain the signed scope and approval record before scheduling externally committed work.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Deliver work and control changes

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Named delivery owners perform the engagement and review customer dependencies. Record requested changes with their cost, timing and acceptance impact; obtain approval before taking on additional obligations.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile delivery evidence and open exceptions

agent-runnable


Compile completed deliverables, time or milestone evidence and unresolved issues against the signed scope. Draft acceptance and invoicing records without claiming that silence proves customer acceptance.

- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Obtain acceptance and close the engagement

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The accountable delivery owner confirms acceptance or disputes through the agreed route. Hand remaining obligations, support and approved invoice evidence to their owners and record lessons for future estimates.

- Verify: An accepted engagement with controlled scope changes, delivery evidence and a reconciled commercial handover.
- Sources: [UK government contract management principles](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/commercial-capability-contract-management-standards/contract-management-principles)
